base4.name: Alakazam
base4.effect: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

base4.name: Blastoise
base4.effect: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

base4.name: Chansey
base4.effect: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

base4.name: Charizard
base4.effect: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

base4.name: Clefable
base4.effect: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

base4.name: Clefairy
base4.effect: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

base4.name: Gyarados
base4.effect: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

base4.name: Hitmonchan
base4.effect: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

base4.name: Magneton
base4.effect: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

base4.name: Mewtwo
base4.effect: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

base4.name: Nidoking
base4.effect: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

base4.name: Nidoqueen
base4.effect: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

base4.name: Ninetales
base4.effect: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

base4.name: Pidgeot
base4.effect: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

base4.name: Poliwrath
base4.effect: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

base4.name: Raichu
base4.effect: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

base4.name: Scyther
base4.effect: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of it.

base4.name: Venusaur
base4.effect: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

base4.name: Wigglytuff
base4.effect: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

base4.name: Zapdos
base4.effect: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

base4.name: Beedrill
base4.effect: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

base4.name: Dragonair
base4.effect: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

base4.name: Dugtrio
base4.effect: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

base4.name: Electabuzz
base4.effect: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

base4.name: Electrode
base4.effect: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

base4.name: Kangaskhan
base4.effect: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.

base4.name: Mr. Mime
base4.effect: If interrupted while miming, it will slap around the enemy with its broad hands.

base4.name: Pidgeotto
base4.effect: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

base4.name: Pinsir
base4.effect: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

base4.name: Snorlax
base4.effect: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

base4.name: Venomoth
base4.effect: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

base4.name: Victreebel
base4.effect: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

base4.name: Arcanine
base4.effect: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

base4.name: Butterfree
base4.effect: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

base4.name: Charmeleon
base4.effect: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

base4.name: Dewgong
base4.effect: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

base4.name: Dodrio
base4.effect: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

base4.name: Dratini
base4.effect: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

base4.name: Exeggutor
base4.effect: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

base4.name: Farfetch'd
base4.effect: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

base4.name: Fearow
base4.effect: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

base4.name: Growlithe
base4.effect: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

base4.name: Haunter
base4.effect: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

base4.name: Ivysaur
base4.effect: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

base4.name: Jynx
base4.effect: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

base4.name: Kadabra
base4.effect: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

base4.name: Kakuna
base4.effect: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

base4.name: Lickitung
base4.effect: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

base4.name: Machoke
base4.effect: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

base4.name: Magikarp
base4.effect: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

base4.name: Magmar
base4.effect: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

base4.name: Marowak
base4.effect: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to K.O. targets.

base4.name: Nidorina
base4.effect: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

base4.name: Nidorino
base4.effect: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

base4.name: Parasect
base4.effect: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

base4.name: Persian
base4.effect: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

base4.name: Poliwhirl
base4.effect: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

base4.name: Raticate
base4.effect: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

base4.name: Rhydon
base4.effect: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

base4.name: Seaking
base4.effect: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

base4.name: Seel
base4.effect: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

base4.name: Tauros
base4.effect: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

base4.name: Wartortle
base4.effect: Often hides in water to stalk unweary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

base4.name: Weepinbell
base4.effect: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

base4.name: Abra
base4.effect: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

base4.name: Bellsprout
base4.effect: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

base4.name: Bulbasaur
base4.effect: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

base4.name: Caterpie
base4.effect: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

base4.name: Charmander
base4.effect: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

base4.name: Cubone
base4.effect: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

base4.name: Diglett
base4.effect: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

base4.name: Doduo
base4.effect: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

base4.name: Drowzee
base4.effect: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

base4.name: Exeggcute
base4.effect: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

base4.name: Gastly
base4.effect: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

base4.name: Goldeen
base4.effect: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

base4.name: Jigglypuff
base4.effect: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

base4.name: Machop
base4.effect: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

base4.name: Magnemite
base4.effect: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

base4.name: Meowth
base4.effect: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

base4.name: Metapod
base4.effect: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

base4.name: Nidoran ♀
base4.effect: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

base4.name: Nidoran ♂
base4.effect: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

base4.name: Onix
base4.effect: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

base4.name: Paras
base4.effect: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

base4.name: Pidgey
base4.effect: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

base4.name: Pikachu
base4.effect: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

base4.name: Poliwag
base4.effect: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

base4.name: Rattata
base4.effect: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

base4.name: Rhyhorn
base4.effect: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

base4.name: Sandshrew
base4.effect: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

base4.name: Spearow
base4.effect: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

base4.name: Squirtle
base4.effect: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

base4.name: Starmie
base4.effect: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

base4.name: Staryu
base4.effect: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

base4.name: Tangela
base4.effect: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

base4.name: Venonat
base4.effect: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

base4.name: Voltorb
base4.effect: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

base4.name: Vulpix
base4.effect: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

base4.name: Weedle
base4.effect: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.
